label: Compound Interest
summary: Interest calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods.
plain_descriptions: money snowballing because earnings get added back to the pile

label: Cookie
summary: A small piece of data stored on the user's browser by websites to retain state and track browsing activity.
plain_descriptions: small browser file websites save to remember your login
web tracker banner you click accept on

label: Interest Rate
summary: The proportion of an amount loaned which a lender charges as interest to the borrower, typically expressed as an annual percentage.
plain_descriptions: percentage fee charged for borrowing money
percentage reward earned on savings per year

label: Principal
summary: The original sum of money lent, invested, or borrowed before interest accrues.
plain_descriptions: original sum of money borrowed or invested
money before any interest gets calculated

label: Return on Investment
summary: A performance metric used to evaluate the efficiency or profitability of an investment relative to its cost.
plain_descriptions: how much money you make back compared to what you spent
performance metric measuring profitability of an expense

label: Simple Interest
summary: Interest calculated exclusively on the original principal amount for the entirety of the loan or deposit period.
plain_descriptions: interest calculated solely on the initial deposit
fixed interest payment that never compounds

label: Token
summary: Small chunk of text, typically subword units, processed by large language models.
plain_descriptions: unit AI uses to count text chunks
why AI charges per prompt length
